findings.summary: TestEntryReportCallerRace and TestEntryFormatterRace start goroutines without waiting (no WaitGroup), so the tests may return before goroutines run, letting them pass without the fix and risking goroutines touching t after the test finishes.
Holding Logger.mu during Formatter.Format serializes formatting across goroutines, and a custom Formatter calling a locking Logger method (e.g. SetLevel) would now deadlock.
Comment 'logging before SetReportCaller' was copy-pasted into TestEntryFormatterRace where it should refer to SetFormatter, and 'likelyhood' is misspelled in both places.
